concerns.text: The assumption 'The eBird and NOAA/PRISM datasets are free from systematic biases that would invalidate the phenology‑climate correlations' (Assumption about data quality) is factually unsupported. eBird citizen‑science data are known to exhibit observer effort and detection bias, which can confound phenology metrics. Ignoring this major source of bias undermines the validity of any inferred climate‑phenology relationship.

Success Criterion SC-001 measures 'statistical power and effect size stability ... against the total number of migratory species present'. Power is a deterministic function of sample size; using the number of species (which determines sample size) as the validation target makes the claim tautological and non‑empirical. The criterion does not provide an independent assessment of power and therefore constitutes a circular validation.
